title: Sketchpad SDK Vanguard — Quickstart Manifest
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, opinionated quickstart + handoff journal for the Sketchpad SDK experiment. The goal: a tiny, high-confidence path for an engineer to go from zero to an instrumented sample integration (3 sample calls) in under 30 minutes, plus a short 2-hour workshop flow that product/solutions can run with customers.

Context / motivation:
- We keep shipping longer, heavy quickstarts. That creates cognitive load.
- Sketchpad is our small-footprint client meant for low-latency single-node apps (mobile clients, edge workers). We need a minimalist onramp that proves value quickly and clearly shows telemetry and failure modes.

Target persona:
- Primary: backend/frontend engineer who needs one small client to call Redwood Hosted API with low overhead.
- Secondary: Prod Eng/Platform engineer validating telemetry, SRE running smoke tests.

What success looks like (metrics):
- 90% of participants complete the 30-minute path without asking >1 clarifying question.
- 3 sample calls successfully executed and visible in the Console (latency + token cost).
- Telemetry contract validated by Product (trace ids present, sample metrics).

Quickstart constraints and non-goals:
- Keep dependencies to one small binary or 2 small NPM packages. No monorepo pulls.
- Not a full SDK feature doc; this is a fast, opinionated path.
- Not covering Dedicated/Private setup; those are separate flows.

30-minute path (concise):
- Prereqs: node >=18 or python3.11, an active Redwood dev API key (team/dev free credits).
- Step 0 (2 mins): clone the tiny sample repo: git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sketchpad-mini && cd sketchpad-mini
- Step 1 (5 mins): install and configure: npm ci && export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
- Step 2 (5 mins): run hello sample: node examples/hello.js -> returns streamed tokens
- Step 3 (10 mins): instrument telemetry: node examples/hello_with_trace.js (adds x-redwood-trace header and posts to local Zipkin stub)
  - Verify in Console: navigate to Console > Requests > filter by test-api-key (should show 3 entries)
- Step 4 (5 mins): tweak model params to test graceful degradation: run degrade.js (switch to smaller model, test 503 fallback)

30-minute path — common friction and remedies (notes to self):
- If user sees CORS issues: quick workaround and schedule follow-up to ship CORS header example for in-browser: add Proxy microproxy example.
- Missing env var confusion: add one-liner for macOS/Linux and Windows.

2-hour workshop flow (for SEs/solutions):
- 0–10m: goals + account setup + badge for live demo creds
- 10–30m: 30-minute path above, pair-program with participant
- 30–60m: add user-flow sample (simple Q&A assistant using chat endpoint, switching to streaming)
- 60–90m: telemetry deep-dive: show trace propagation, token breakdown, cost math per request.
- 90–120m: failure modes + recovery strategies (circuit breaker, cached prefix, model fallback). Give simple exercise: implement fallback to 'small-model' and measure latency delta.

Minimal sandbox commands (copypasta for README):
- git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sketchpad-mini.git
- cd sketchpad-mini && npm ci
- export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_ABC123
- node examples/hello_with_trace.js

Telemetry contract (mini example to be copied into README):
- Required headers: x-redwood-trace-id (uuid v4), x-client-version (semver), x-client-env (dev|staging|prod)
- Minimal JSON body to log locally (we also show how to forward to Console):
  {
    "trace_id": "<uuid>",
    "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "tokens": 128,
    "latency_ms": 142
  }

Edge-case recipes (short):
- Slow network: enable quick local cache for last prompt prefix (sample included in cache.js).
- Partial stream: restart from last known token using KV cache key; sample code pattern shows how to resume.
- Rate limit bounce: show exponential backoff snippet + exp backoff jitter.

Gating checklist before marking quickstart final:
- [ ] Single-file README with one-liners for macOS/Win/Linux
- [ ] Example makes a visible Console trace with trace id
- [ ] CORS example or one-liner proxy added to repo
- [ ] Minimal unit test that runs the hello sample in CI (uses mock env key)
- [ ] PR that updates SDK landing page with 30-minute path link (GH PR #432 reference below)

Handoff notes for content/marketing:
- We need a short 90-sec demo video asset (screen + terminal) showing 30-minute path. Use the sample repo and overlay callouts for trace id and token meter.
- One-pager: "Sketchpad in 3 calls" (hero image: terminal + Console panel).

Outstanding questions / risks (to resolve):
- Q1: Do we allow the sample to hardcode a demo API key for workshop ease? Risk: key leakage. Temporary solution: ephemeral badges via Console; need eng support (ticket DEVX-221).
- Q2: For mobile in-browser CORS: do we recommend a tiny Edge proxy maintained by us? (Ops cost).

Quick links and artifacts (for reviewers):
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVX/SKETCHPAD-Design
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432
- Issue: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DEVX-221

Next actions (short-term):
- Aisha: draft README single-file and upload a tiny GIF for demo (due 2026-03-08).
- Diego: wire ephemeral badge flow with Console team (start: 2026-03-03).
- Maya: record 90-sec demo, slot for content review (due 2026-03-10).

Notes to self (voice):
- Keep the language terse. Avoid API surface exploration in quickstart; that's what the longer docs are for.
- We should iterate this doc in public working sessions — the 30-minute path is the canonical experiment.

Appendix: example fallback pseudocode (copy into examples/):
- async function requestWithFallback(payload) {
    try { return await callRedwood(payload); }
    catch (e) { if (isCapacityError(e)) return await callRedwood({ ...payload, model: 'small-model' }); else throw e; }
  }

End of manifest.
